cases.kind: original two-input oscillator and first-order filter

model.name: Original two-input mechanical ROM
limitations: One stored representative supplies both members of each nonreal conjugate pair. Real poles contribute once.
Response uses the matrices printed in this file. The aircraft baseline, full descriptor and ASWING-specific Bode reconstruction corrections are not contained in a ROM file.
Unknown variable and unit labels are preserved. Original files generally do not specify physical input units; these remain unspecified rather than inferred.
Importing an external ROM does not validate the underlying aircraft physics or attach it to the current .asw model.

cases.source:
! Original OpenSwing harmonic verification example. SI input units.
! Fixed root, axial stiffness k=500 N/m, tip mass m=2 kg, damping time .02 s.
! Engine setting is a force in N along +y. Set gravity to zero, alpha=0.
! Tip y response per unit setting: 1 / [500*(1+i*.02*omega)-2*omega^2].
Name
Instrumented spring-mass demonstrator
End
Unit
L 1 m
T 1 s
F 1 N
End
Constant
9.80665 1.225 340.294
End
Reference
2 1 2
End
Ground
1 0 0
End
Weight
1 2 0 2 0 19.6133
End
Engine
1 0 1 2 0 2 0 0 1 0 1 0 -1 0 0
End
Beam 1
Axial spring
t y EA tdeps
0 0 1000 .02
2 2 1000 .02
End

! Default body-aligned pylon-tip pitot, accelerometer and GPS.
Sensor
1 1 0 0 0 .2
2 1 2 .3 2 .2
End

model.name: Instrumented spring-mass demonstrator
limitations: One stored representative supplies both members of each nonreal conjugate pair. Real poles contribute once.
Response uses the matrices printed in this file. The aircraft baseline, full descriptor and ASWING-specific Bode reconstruction corrections are not contained in a ROM file.
Unknown variable and unit labels are preserved. Original files generally do not specify physical input units; these remain unspecified rather than inferred.
Importing an external ROM does not validate the underlying aircraft physics or attach it to the current .asw model.
The nine external samples have zero control/direct matrices. Their numerical forced dynamics are therefore not a nonzero transfer benchmark.
The original independent mechanical and newly generated examples provide nonzero SISO/MIMO, conjugate, feedthrough and SI-scaling checks.
Printed ROM transfer matrices do not contain all data used by ASWING Bode reconstruction corrections; executable interoperability and aircraft physics parity are not established.
